title: TS-64 Slim computer image: no Chromium, add git, browser becomes an optional capability
description: Decision (user, 2026-10-07): the computer only needs files, git and basic editing; no Chromium, and it can stay a very small task (0.25 CPU, 0.5 GB). (1) computer/Dockerfile: remove xvfb, x11-utils, chromium and fonts-liberation, add git (keep ca-certificates); update computer/entrypoint.sh if it starts a display; measure and report the image size before and after (docker build, docker images). (2) The host boot must not fail without Chromium: the browser gate in computer/host/src/boot.ts runs chromium --version; browser readiness becomes a capability that is simply reported unavailable (browser_ready false) when Chromium is absent, never a boot failure, per the capability-gated readiness design (readiness is per capability); the model tool browse then answers with a clear message that the browser capability is not available on this computer, or is not offered, whichever is the smallest correct change with the existing request_computer_capability design. Keep the Chromium executor and the browser features (they describe an optional capability); only the default image changes. (3) Update conversation/test/computer-image-structure.test.ts and the cucumber features that assume a browser at boot; add scenarios for a host that boots without a browser and a browse call on such a computer; mutation checks. Do not push images or touch AWS in this ticket.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Merged via PR 472, deployed to development (stacks UPDATE_COMPLETE, develop CI green). Image 944 MB to 356 MB (arm64), git 2.39.5, no Chromium or display. The host boots without a browser and reports it unavailable; browse answers with a clear message and starts nothing. NOT YET LIVE: the new image is not pushed to ECR (needs the user's go) so the running computers still use the old image until then. Known gap: a browse action parked before the host reports unavailable fails with the executor's Chromium-not-found error.

right_now_summary: The smaller image is deployed to development, but ECR still serves the old image until approval.
